SLE.note: Document concerns a cyberbullying prosecution; no national body or strategy stated.

facts.fact: The report says a Freetown councillor was charged under sections 44(1)(b) and 44(2)(b) of the Cybersecurity and Crime Act 2021.

Sierraloaded reports a Freetown councillor charged with cyberstalking and cyberbullying under the Cybersecurity and Crime Act 2021, prosecuted at Pademba Road Court, pleading not guilty on a first appearance with bail granted.
